channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Joe Schoen relegated to Giants’ scouting dept. with Dawn Aponte reporting to John Harbaugh
item.description: Giants GM Joe Schoen basically is relegated to running the franchise's scouting staff and department in John Harbaugh's new organizational structure, the Daily News has been told.

item.title: Injured seabird desperately pecks at hospital door for help
item.description: The black cormorant had a triple fishing hook stuck in its beak.

item.title: ‘Stranger Things’ star Maya Hawke, musician Christian Lee Hutson wed in NYC
item.description: Maya Hawke tied the knot with musician Christian Lee Hutson Saturday in a star-studded Valentine's Day wedding attended by many of the Netflix breakout's "Stranger Things" costars.

item.title: Queens laundromat worker defended mom in clash with customer before being shot to death
item.description: The gunman was dressed in head-to-toe camaflouge and neither the mother nor cops know if he's the same man who menaced the victim earlier Saturday.

item.title: Family cleared as suspects in Nancy Guthrie disappearance: sheriff
item.description: Members of the Guthrie family, including Nancy Guthrie’s three children and their spouses, have been cleared as possible suspects in the Arizona woman's disappearance, officials said Monday.

item.title: Murder not a ‘crime of violence,’ Brooklyn federal judge rules in terrorism case
item.description: Because the federal first-degree murder statute allows for unintentional and accidental killings, murder can't strictly be called an act of violence, the judge ruled.

item.title: Cuban drivers face monthslong wait for gasoline in a government app designed to reduce lines
item.description: Fuels shortages and blackouts have been intensifying in Cuba this month.

item.title: Hollywood remembers a legend as tributes pour in for actor Robert Duvall
item.description: Tributes poured in Monday as his friends, fans and Hollywood contemporaries fondly remembered Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall following his death a day prior.

item.title: James Van Der Beek, wife had paid off nearly $270K in tax debt
item.description: James Van Der Beek, who died of colorectal cancer last week, and wife Kimberly once owed nearly $270,000 in tax debt, which resulted in a lien. They ultimately paid off the debt in 2022.

item.title: Asking Eric: Neighbors and acquaintances crash private parties
item.description: Dear Eric: My spouse and I are senior citizens, and we occasionally have small gatherings, or what I intended to be small gatherings.
